components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',Tahoma,sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--foreground,#17372f)}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ring,#b34114)}.ds-nav [aria-current="page"]{border-bottom:2px solid var(--ring,#b34114);padding-bottom:4px}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#b34114);outline-offset:5px;}

components.name: Portfolio filters
components.description: Square filters show selected state through aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-filters button{font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',Tahoma,sans-serif);font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;padding:10px 19px;min-height:44px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#59665d);background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;white-space:normal}.ds-filters button:hover{background:var(--secondary,#e5e9df)}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--primary,#173e33);color:var(--paper,#fffdf7)}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#b34114);outline-offset:5px;}

components.name: Photographic project card
components.description: An actual local illustrative photograph with open caption; no enclosing raised card.
components.css: .ds-project{max-width:540px;color:var(--foreground,#17372f);font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',Tahoma,sans-serif)}.ds-project-image{overflow:hidden;background:var(--muted,#e9e8df)}.ds-project-image img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.4;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-project:hover img{transform:scale(1.025)}.ds-project-caption{padding-top:18px}.ds-project-caption p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#59665d);margin:0 0 7px}.ds-project-caption h3{font-family:var(--font-display,'Noto Kufi Arabic Variable',Tahoma,sans-serif);font-size:18px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.8;margin:0}.ds-project a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-project a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}.ds-project a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#b34114);outline-offset:5px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-project-image img{transition:none}}

components.name: Editorial service row
components.description: Strong Arabic service name and quieter specification beneath, separated by rules.

components.css: .ds-service{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 5px;color:var(--foreground,#17372f);border-block:1px solid var(--border,#cbcfc4);text-decoration:none;transition:color .25s,background .25s}.ds-service>span{font-family:var(--font-display,'Noto Kufi Arabic Variable',Tahoma,sans-serif);font-size:21px;font-weight:600}.ds-service small{display:block;font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',Tahoma,sans-serif);font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted-foreground,#59665d);margin-top:2px}.ds-service:hover{color:var(--ring,#b34114);background:var(--secondary,#e5e9df)}.ds-service:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#b34114);outline-offset:5px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-service{transition:none}}

components.name: Mobile consent panel

components.html:

components.css: .ds-consent{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;max-width:460px;padding:13px 15px;background:var(--paper,#fffdf7);color:var(--foreground,#17372f);border:1px solid var(--border,#cbcfc4);box-shadow:0 7px 30px #12291d20;font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',Tahoma,sans-serif)}.ds-consent strong{font-size:14px}.ds-consent p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted-foreground,#59665d);margin:4px 0 0}.ds-consent-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-consent-actions button{min-height:44px;padding:6px 10px;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.9;border:1px solid var(--primary,#173e33);border-radius:2px;background:var(--primary,#173e33);color:var(--paper,#fffdf7);cursor:pointer}.ds-consent-actions button:hover{background:#295444}.ds-consent-actions .ds-consent-outline{background:transparent;border-color:var(--border,#cbcfc4);color:var(--primary,#173e33)}.ds-consent-actions .ds-consent-outline:hover{background:var(--secondary,#e5e9df)}.ds-consent-actions button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#b34114);outline-offset:5px;}

narrative.northStar: A Baghdad signmaker’s printed sample book
narrative.overview:
The system borrows its material character from print production: warm ivory stock, deep green ink, decisive orange vinyl and generous original photography. Strong Arabic sans-serif headings, precise rules and nearly square controls keep it commercially direct and grounded in Baghdad.

Photography carries the service and material story. Content uses editorial rows, offset image compositions and practical ledgers, while quotation and policy surfaces stay quieter and easier to read. These are recurring layout choices, not a requirement to repeat the home page on every route.
keyCharacteristics: Arabic RTL with strong, serif-free display typography.
Warm paper surfaces, green ink and concentrated orange emphasis.
Original generated photography, openly labeled as illustrative.
Flat editorial structure, fine rules and precise control corners.
Honest local-only interaction states and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Material Evidence Rule
rules.body: Let photographs show the surface, finish and installation context. Preserve the illustrative disclosure; never imply that generated examples are completed client work.

rules.name: The Arabic Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep Arabic text in normal case, allow generous leading and preserve the established font families. Do not compress text into fixed-height containers.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate normal sections with stock tones, spacing and rules. Reserve the custom ambient shadow for the floating consent panel.

dos: Do retain RTL flow and use logical spacing properties for reusable layouts.
Do use the self-hosted Arabic display and body fonts with generous line height.
Do use the original local photographs and keep illustrative and fictional-data disclosures visible.
Do preserve the corrected mobile consent title, body text and controls at 14px, 12px and 44px minimum height respectively.
Do provide visible focus, inline validation, a real empty state and a reduced-motion path.
Do describe form completion as a local simulation with a download; selected files are not uploaded.
donts: Don't introduce a SaaS visual style, excessive gradients, pill controls or repetitive card grids.
Don't add decorative shadows to normal cards, service rows or material ledgers.
Don't replace the photographic material story with stock illustration or fabricated client proof.
Don't treat synthetic sidecar tonal ramps as additional approved production colors.
Don't generalize the final scoped reviewer disposition into comprehensive visual or accessibility certification.
